details:
I had this idea in mind months ago and with the current situation i'd like to suggest it.

It would be a feature where you have the option to build the avatar and store it on your computer's avatars folder instead of the servers, like a test avatar, but that avatar would behave as a normal avatar, which means that it will keep the current avatar with the stored parameter values when switching worlds or avatars, and if a remote user doesn't have that avatar on their avatars folder, it will appear as a fallback. But if they do have it, then they can see it, which is not possible with test avatars obviously.

Making it so only people that you trust can see the avatar, this can avoid ripping from untrusted users or any malicious third party application that can download the avatar from the servers.

It sounds absurd, but it would be a nice feature for many users that want to keep avatars around friend circles only, or just for themselves such as streamers or youtubers that don't need to make its avatar visible to anyone but its audience.

In case that it's not a big hassle to add this, me and many users would appreciate a lot to have this feature. Thanks.
title: Local avatars (not test avatars)
